admission.justification: The journal-conditional alternative was explicitly considered and rejected; future leaf integration cannot replace fresh exact-pair judgment with that stored trust.

alternatives.option: Judge every actual leaf pair again at integration.
alternatives.reason: It needs no trust in a stored record and catches an edited cell or older-build closeout.

alternatives.option: Compare the closeout cell to the operation journal and judge only when it mismatches.
alternatives.reason: The approved settled G1 chooses one fresh gate evaluation instead of making a journal match admission authority.
alternatives.reconsider_when: An approved design proves journal-bound trust without losing exact-pair, current-input judgment.

consequences: One more invariant-gate evaluation per leaf integration; this is not a broad quality, MQC or review operation.
context: Leaf integration previously trusted the closeout cell and its earlier judgment, including when a hand edit or older server supplied it.
decider: MIK-R52@v1 Settled G1, architect under D47
